title: Concept: Firestore rules rejection echoed to a client
description: A Firestore permission error that names the project and path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error confirms the project id and the exact document path that the rules rejected, which turns a blind enumeration into a guided one.
applicability: Deployments that render a Firestore permission error that names the project and path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error confirms the project id and the exact document path that the rules rejected, which turns a blind enumeration into a guided one.
